system.description:
When using the Multiattack trait with a Kunai, Shuriken, or Senbon, you can add your ability modifier to the damage rolled. Also, once per turn, while you are gaining the benefits of this generalization you can spend one Superiority Die as part of casting a Jutsu or making an unarmed or weapon attack. When you do, you gain a bonus to the damage dealt equal to 1d8. This bonus increases to 2d8 at 5th, 3d8 at 11th, 4d8 at 15th and 5d8 at 20th level. If used as part of an unarmed attack, weapon attack or jutsu that affects an area or an unarmed or weapon attack, roll half the listed number of dice, rounded up, minimum 1.

If you use a Maneuver granted by your Scouting Technique (Subclass) as part of an attack or jutsu’s casting, you can use this feature as part of that maneuver, reduce the number of bonus damage by 1 dice when you do.
